title: Classroom and Authored Activity Layout Usability

preflight.note: Captured from installed acceptance observations before any UI redesign. The existing shared checkout edits remain untouched; this work item is recorded on the clean public worktree at canonical base 72a8ecba5a9f0cb5a48188b357a59d796515b40e.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reproduce and document the four observed layout problems in representative Classroom, authored activity, lecture, and long-unit views at supported desktop window sizes.
Define a readable responsive layout for activity prompts, response controls, actions, lesson text, and long units while preserving clear navigation and progress context.
Apply approved layout changes without changing authored runtime evaluation, CourseProgress authority, assessment/remediation semantics, or private course data.
Verify desktop resizing and supported narrow layouts, keyboard-only interaction, visible focus, and accessible labels for all affected controls.
Record before/after usability evidence and pass applicable accessibility and UI validation gates before marking the candidate complete.

source: 2026-10-06 installed private-course acceptance, resumed after verified guided-practice completion.
